title: Assign to the first responder in the group
x:
A ticket routed to a group should stay with that group. New automation actions assign to the first or last responder from the assigned group, counting only that group's replies. Outside replies no longer pull it away.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/assign-to-the-first-responder-in-the-group?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=assign-to-the-first-responder-in-the-group
linkedin:
You route a ticket to the billing group. Someone from sales happens to reply first, and the ticket moves to them and drops out of billing's queue. Nobody meant for that to happen.

NeetoDesk now has two automation actions for this: assign to first responder from the assigned group, and assign to last responder from the assigned group. They count only replies from team members in the ticket's group.

When someone outside the group replies first, the ticket stays unassigned in the group's queue instead of moving to them. A ticket with no group is still assigned to whoever replies first, as before.

Tickets stay where you routed them, and the right team keeps ownership.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/assign-to-the-first-responder-in-the-group?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=assign-to-the-first-responder-in-the-group

title: Automatic replies kept out of your inbox
x:
Out-of-office replies no longer create tickets in NeetoDesk. Autoresponder emails outside an existing conversation go to spam. On an existing ticket they're added as a reply, with no auto-acknowledgement, so no loops.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/automatic-replies-kept-out-of-your-inbox?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=automatic-replies-kept-out-of-your-inbox
linkedin:
Out-of-office and other automatic replies no longer create new tickets in NeetoDesk.

Automatic replies that arrive outside an existing ticket conversation go to spam, keeping them out of your inbox and ticket counts. On an existing ticket, the reply is added as a customer reply, and NeetoDesk does not send an automatic acknowledgement back, so there are no reply loops.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/automatic-replies-kept-out-of-your-inbox?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=automatic-replies-kept-out-of-your-inbox
